question: Which chapter of the Śrī Tattvacintāmaṇi concludes at this point?
premises: The text names its author as Śrī Pūrṇānanda Paramahaṃsa
The work is titled Śrī Tattvacintāmaṇi
The section is identified by an ordinal number
inference: This marks the conclusion of the eighth chapter of the Śrī Tattvacintāmaṇi composed by Śrī Pūrṇānanda Paramahaṃsa.
plain_english: Thus ends the eighth chapter in the Śrī Tattvacintāmaṇi composed by Śrī Pūrṇānanda Paramahaṃsa.
